caption: The drawing is painted on a vertically-oriented, rectangular piece of wood with visible natural grain and knot holes. The central figure is a woman dressed in a long, black robe and a white-edged black veil, standing upright and facing forward. Her right hand is holding a black cross with two crossbars, while her left hand holds a small, yellowish human skull. The woman's face is pale, and simple black lines outline her facial features, with a calm expression. Behind her, there is a multicolored arch or mandorla shape, outlined in shades of yellow, orange, red, and green. On either side of the figure, in the background, there are two green, triangular shapes that resemble hills. The lower part of the image shows a ground area in faded brown and yellow hues. The colors are muted and faded, and the edges of the painting are worn, with the wood showing through in places.
title: Santo (Santa Rita)
